bullet: Refused write leaves no trace (`F31.fenced-write-no-trace`), known bug.
script:
PS=$(control-agent-server api PATCH "<redacted:session-cookie>/$F" --json '{"title": "QA F31 stale owner"}' --expect 4xx,5xx \
  --save F31.fenced-write-no-trace/patch | jq .status)
control-agent-server state cat meta.json --conversation "$F" --check title eq 'QA F31 new owner'
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$F" --check title ne 'QA F31 stale owner' --save F31.fenced-write-no-trace/get  # bug
echo "refused PATCH answered $PS"
test "$PS" -lt 500  # bug
